swingingsigns.options.title: Swinging Hanging Signs
swingingsigns.options.enabled.tooltip: Turn all sign movement on or off. When it is off, every hanging sign hangs still like in vanilla.
swingingsigns.options.wall.tooltip: Let signs hung from a wall bracket swing too. Turn it off to keep them still.
swingingsigns.options.wind.tooltip: How much signs sway on their own. At 0% they only move when something pushes them.
swingingsigns.options.push.tooltip: How hard players, mobs, items and minecarts push the signs they pass.
swingingsigns.options.weather.tooltip: Signs swing more in rain and much more in a thunderstorm.
swingingsigns.options.reset.tooltip: Put every setting back to how it was when you installed Swinging Hanging Signs.
